MaskStrategy: A preference for faster compiling or faster masks.
MaskStrategy.FAST_MASKS: Prefer faster masks over faster compiling.
MaskStrategy.FAST_COMPILE: Prefer faster compiling over faster masks.
Vocab: Each token ID and its bytes.
Extern: A named placeholder in a grammar.
Extern.kind: What the extern can be bound to.
Externs: Externs by name, in declaration order.
Module.bind: Binds externs by name. If one fails, none are bound.
Module.precompile: Compiles what it can for `vocab` now, even with externs unbound.
Module.compile: Reuses any precompiled work, which must be for the same vocabulary.
Module.save: Serializes the module with its precompiled work. Other GLRMask versions may not load it.
Grammar.from_json_schema: Parses a [JSON Schema](https://github.com/IsaacBreen/glrmask/blob/main/GUIDE.md#grammar-formats), given as JSON text or a dict.
Grammar.bind: Binds externs by name. If one fails, none are bound.
Constraint: A compiled grammar, ready to use.
Constraint.mask_bit_len: One more than the largest token ID.
Constraint.save: Serializes the constraint. Other GLRMask versions may not load it.
Constraint.load: `vocab` must be the one it was compiled with.
ConstraintState: The state of one generated sequence.
ConstraintState.mask_bit_len: One more than the largest token ID.
ConstraintState.mask: Which tokens may come next: packed `uint32` bits, or with `dtype=bool` one boolean per token ID.
ConstraintState.fill_mask: Writes the packed mask into `bitmask`, zeroing any extra words. Releases the GIL.
ConstraintState.commit_token: Returns `False`, and ends the state, if the token isn't allowed.
ConstraintState.commit_tokens: Returns how many were committed. Stops at the first token that isn't allowed, which ends the state.
ConstraintState.commit_bytes: Returns `False`, and ends the state, if the bytes aren't allowed.
ConstraintState.is_accepting: Whether what's committed is a complete match. If so, allow EOS (don't commit it).
ConstraintState.is_terminated: Whether nothing more can be committed.
GLRMaskError.kind: One of `"syntax"`, `"invalid_input"`, `"compilation"`, `"resource_limit"`, `"strategy_unsupported"`, `"serialization"`, `"internal"`. More may be added.
ConstraintState.forced_bytes: The bytes the grammar requires next. Stops where a token from a token set, the end of the grammar, or more than one byte could come next. May return only part of a long run; call again after committing.
Grammar.externs: A snapshot; read it again after `bind()`.
Module.externs: A snapshot; read it again after `bind()`.
